svg.title: Late at the desk
svg.desc: Stage two different source-bearing screens, a half-full drink and sparse paper around an obscured seated creator. Warm office light marks the change of register; source reading remains the focal action. Keep the recurring home window and shelves distinct from institutional review settings; this domestic interior remains reconstructed.
